response.evidence_snippet: using a Next Generation cascade impactor at 15 L/min: aerosol output 1.18 mL, aerosol output rate 0.26 mL/min, mass median aerodynamic diameter (MMAD) 3.8 µm, geometric standard deviation 2.1, respirable fraction (below 5 µm) 68 %. Test medication 0.9 % sodium chloride with 2.5 mL fill volume
